categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Modifies `BufferedWriter::flush()` in `src/streams.h` to properly handle failed writes during exception unwinding.
categories.rationale: Prevents `std::terminate` crashes by clearing pending bytes before write attempts in `BufferedWriter::flush()`. When writes fail and throw an exception, relying on destructors to flush previously triggered a second exception and immediate termination during stack unwinding.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Modifies `BlockManager::WriteBlock` and `WriteBlockUndo` in `src/node/blockstorage.cpp` to handle write errors gracefully.
categories.rationale: Ensures disk write failures during block and undo storage trigger clean node shutdown rather than an unhandled process termination. Disks running out of space during block writes previously triggered an unhandled exception in `BufferedWriter`'s destructor, aborting the process without clean error reporting.
